ranking: GitHub stars descending; non-fork, non-archived; primary language per GitHub
eligibility: Web applications (including production learning platforms), HTTP servers/frameworks/libraries, browser UI libraries, and web-specific site/build tools. Exclude tutorial/list repositories, general runtimes, coding agents, desktop-only apps, ML engines without a primary web UI, and generic infrastructure/networking tools.
expectations: Reviewed primary project paths and static manifests. Framework checks cover consumers; identity checks separately probe framework implementation packages. Catalog checks require a locally declared version rather than a catalog reference. Workspace checks use representative declared members. Not an exhaustive precision/recall oracle.

extensions.eligibility: Same web-project criteria as existing corpus, including production web solution templates (as with create-react-app), excluding native/desktop-first apps, general runtimes, lists, and tutorial collections.

extensions.query: GitHub query topic:deno archived:false fork:false; sort=stars; order=desc. languageRank stores raw topic-query rank (historical field name), webRank stores eligible web rank. API first 100 results retained in research/github-search.json.
extensions.eligibility: Same web-first scope as prior45: applications, HTTP frameworks/libraries, browser UI and web site/build tools; require actual Deno config. Exclude runtimes, lists/tutorials, generic SQL/security/translation/CLI libraries, and optional-Deno tools without Deno config.
extensions.note: Deno is a runtime ecosystem group, not a new language. Primary-language checks stay javascript/typescript.
